info.name: Stedi Healthcare Claims Claim acknowledgments Providers API

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of elements to return in a page. If not specified, the default is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The `nextPageToken` value from a previous response. You can use this to get the next page of results. If not set, Stedi returns the first page of results.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Filter for providers with properties matching a query string. You can provide all or part of a provider name, NPI, or tax ID. The search is case-insensitive and supports fuzzy matching.

For example, providing `?filter=OS` returns providers with names containing `os` (such as `Joseph`).

params.name: providerNpis
params.description: Filter for providers with NPIs matching any value in this list.

params.name: providerTaxIds
params.description: Filter for providers with tax IDs matching any value in this list.

items.docs: Lists providers with optional filtering and pagination.
Creates a new provider record. Providers must be created before they can be enrolled with payers.

params.name: providerId
params.description: The unique ID Stedi assigned to the provider when it was created in the system.

items.docs: Retrieves a provider record by its ID. This operation returns the complete provider details including contact information.

params.name: providerId
params.description: The Stedi-assigned identifier for the provider you want to update.

items.docs: Updates an existing provider's information. Note that NPI and tax ID cannot be changed after creation.
